subject: Lawsuit Aims to Stop U.F.C. Fights at White House on Trump’s Birthday
posts:
Turning the People's House into an Octagon. A birthday bash that externalizes private entertainment costs onto public dignity.

UFC at the White House
Evidence: private party, public venue use, personal extraction
#Aletheia #Politics

The event is framed as a private birthday celebration and a sporting event for allies and friends within the executive residence.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

The reality is the extraction of public prestige and taxpayer-funded infrastructure for personal and political gain.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Using the White House for a private UFC event is a structural breach of the public trust and institutional purpose.
A federal lawsuit has been filed to block a UFC event scheduled at the White House for President Trump's birthday, alleging the plan is unlawfully self-serving.

The Bright Side:
Celebrating a birthday and supporting sports are generally positive social activities when conducted in an appropriate private context.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is WHERE. A private celebration (Q1/Q4) is being forced into a sacred public domain (Q3).

It is a structural bait-and-switch: claiming a 'party' while extracting the value of a national monument.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between a 'private party' and the use of the executive mansion...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. It is the definition of extraction: private joy at public expense with no systemic return.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public institutions lose their sanctity when used as private playgrounds.

The Unavoidable Lie: That this is just a normal birthday party.
